name: Forgejo
short_desc: Lightweight self-hosted software forge: Git hosting, code review, issues and CI
author: forgejo
description: Forgejo is a self-hosted lightweight software forge. It hosts Git repositories over HTTPS and SSH, with pull requests and code review, issues and project boards, a wiki, releases, a package registry, and Forgejo Actions for CI. It is a community-run, 100% free software fork of Gitea.

form_fields.label: SSH port
form_fields.hint: Host port Git-over-SSH is published on, and the port Forgejo shows in SSH clone URLs. Must be free on the host.
